title: Aluminium — Recovered Bibliography
body:
# Aluminium — Recovered Bibliography

These are source accessions recovered from the supplied conversations. Registration and a working URL do not establish that a source supports every associated claim. Individual citation review remains open. Entries with the same DOI are one work, not independent corroboration.

## SRC-000278

[The NUBASE2020 evaluation of nuclear physics properties](https://doi.org/10.1088/1674-1137/abddae). Chinese Physics C · 2021.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW. Same work as SRC-000008.

## SRC-000279

[NIST Atomic Spectra Database — Aluminium Ionization Energies](https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/ASD/ie.pl?spectra=Al&units=1&unc_out=1). National Institute of Standards and Technology.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW. Same work as SRC-000005.

## SRC-000280

[NIST Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions for Aluminum](https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/Compositions/stand_alone.pl?ele=Al). National Institute of Standards and Technology.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.

## SRC-000281

[Standard Atomic Weights 2024](https://www.ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm). Commission on Isotopic Abundances and Atomic Weights.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.

## SRC-000282

[Persistent Lines of Neutral Aluminum (Al I)](https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Handbook/Tables/aluminumtable3.htm). National Institute of Standards and Technology.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.

## SRC-000283

[Alumina: discriminative analysis using 3D correlation of solid-state NMR parameters](https://doi.org/10.1039/C8CS00321A). Chemical Society Reviews.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.

## SRC-000284

[Persistent Lines of Singly Ionized Aluminum (Al II)](https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Handbook/Tables/aluminumtable4.htm). National Institute of Standards and Technology.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.

## SRC-000285

[Wavelengths and Energy Level Classifications for the Spectra of Aluminum (Al I through Al XIII)](https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/ASD/lines_hold.pl?el=Al). National Institute of Standards and Technology · 1991.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.

## SRC-000286

27Al NMR Study of the Metal Cluster Compound Al50C120H180. Journal of Cluster Science · 2007.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW. **Specific source URL or bibliographic identification still needed.**

## SRC-000287

[Beta decay of 36Mg and 36Al: Identification of a beta-decaying isomer in 36Al](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevC.108.014329). Physical Review C · 2023.

Review: CITATION-RECOVERED-NEEDS-REVIEW.
